title: When the Passage Burns
premise: Desert ranger Odile Ishikawa chases a thief across the saltflats and recovers a chest bearing the seal of Vessia, a drowned nation erased from maps a generation ago. The chest holds concession permits that expire at the spring equinox, and whoever holds them can claim the river's forbidden source—where the water that keeps the desert alive is secretly diverted by the ruling Combine. Odile gathers a found family of outcasts to run the river upstream, discovering the thief he chased is the Combine's own disavowed daughter. In the end, Odile must choose between loyalty to his crew, who want to sell the permits, and the truth that the source belongs to no one; he burns the permits at the source, breaking the Combine's claim and freeing the water, knowing the act will make him a hunted man but finally a home for his people.
about_author: Petra Sandoval is a former river guide who spent a decade mapping dry waterways across three continents before turning to fiction. She writes adventure stories about people who keep moving because the map has forgotten them.

chapters.title: Salt and Signatures
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Tracking a thief across the saltflats, Odile reflects on why he never stops moving—a debt, a name he no longer uses. He catches the thief's trail vanishing into a dry wash. Emotional beat: restless competence masking loneliness.

chapters.title: The Thief Who Wasn't
chapters.summary: Odile corners the thief, Mara, at a ruined cistern, but she's already sold what she stole—except a chest she couldn't open. POV shifts to Mara, wary and sharp. Emotional beat: two hunters realizing they're both prey.

chapters.title: A Dead Nation's Seal
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The chest opens: Vessian permits, stamped and dated, expiring at the equinox. Odile recognizes the seal from his mother's forbidden stories. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into dread as he understands what he's holding.

chapters.title: What the River Remembers
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. She reveals the Combine has agents hunting the chest already; her employer disavowed her. The river gives up a drowned courier's body clutching a partial map upstream. Emotional beat: betrayal and the first fragile alliance.

chapters.title: The Tollhouse at Fenwick Bend
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The pair seek a forger, old Brannoc, to authenticate the permits. Combine riders arrive; a narrow escape by raft. Emotional beat: the crew becomes three; loyalty tested before it's earned.

chapters.title: Brannoc's Price
chapters.summary: Brannoc's POV. The forger agrees to help but demands passage to the source—he was born Vessian and wants to see it before he dies. Emotional beat: grief for a nation, and the weight of witness.

chapters.title: Rapids of the Unmapped
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The river enters canyon country no chart covers. A wrecked Combine barge shows others came before—and died. Emotional beat: awe and mounting danger; the crew's trust deepens through shared labor.

chapters.title: The Girl Who Ran the Water
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Flashback to her upbringing inside the Combine, her father engineering the river's diversion. She confesses the permits were her escape plan. Emotional beat: shame met with unexpected grace.

chapters.title: Portage of Bones
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. They carry the raft past a gorge littered with the dead of the Combine's first expedition. Brannoc falters; Odile carries him. Emotional beat: found family forged in exhaustion and mercy.

chapters.title: The Combine's Offer
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. A Combine envoy, her father's man, offers amnesty and gold for the chest. Brannoc urges refusal; the crew splits on selling. Emotional beat: temptation and the first real fracture.

chapters.title: Night of the Split Vote
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The crew argues by firelight. Mara votes to sell; Odile refuses, and she storms off—straight into the envoy's ambush. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. truth made literal; guilt.

chapters.title: Rescue at the Weir
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Captured, Mara learns her father ordered her disposal. Odile and Brannoc raid the weir camp to free her. Emotional beat: betrayal answered by belonging; Mara chooses the crew.

chapters.title: The Envoy's Ledger
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Stolen from the camp: a ledger proving the Combine diverts the source, starving a dozen downriver towns. Emotional beat: righteous anger; the mission becomes bigger than permits.

chapters.title: White Water, Black Water
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. They run the river's worst rapids as Combine gunboats close in. Brannoc is wounded shielding the chest. Emotional beat: terror, sacrifice, and Odile's dawning realization the chest itself is the trap.

chapters.title: Brannoc's Last Map
chapters.summary: Brannoc's POV. Dying, he finishes the source map from memory and makes Odile swear the water will run free. Emotional beat: inheritance of a promise; burial on the riverbank.

chapters.title: The Gorge of Silence
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The canyon narrows; the river vanishes into a tunnel. Combine forces seal the far end. The crew must climb. Emotional beat: despair at the threshold, hardened resolve.

chapters.title: What Waits at the Source
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. They breach the tunnel to find the source: a vast spring caged behind Combine machinery, her father overseeing it in person. Emotional beat: confrontation with the man who made her.

chapters.title: Father of the Diversion
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Mara faces her father; he offers her the Combine itself if she surrenders the crew. She refuses. Gunfire; the machinery's controls are seized. Emotional beat: truth chosen over blood.

chapters.title: The Burning of the Permits
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. At the equinox deadline, Odile burns the permits before the Combine's claimants' eyes—the claim dies unfiled. Sabotage cracks the diversion gates. Emotional beat: liberation at the cost of safety.

chapters.title: Water Runs Downhill
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The river roars back into its old channels as the Combine's men flee. Her father is swept by his own diverted flood—saved by Mara against her own judgment. Emotional beat: mercy as the final break with him.

chapters.title: Hunted, Together
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The Combine brands them outlaws; warrants spread. But downriver towns, watered again, shelter the crew. Emotional beat: exile transformed into belonging; the cost accepted.

chapters.title: Where the River Begins Again
chapters.summary: Shared POV, alternating. The crew settles at the source as its unchosen wardens, mapping it openly so no one can claim it in the dark. Odile finally stops moving. Emotional beat: stillness, home, and the loyalty that outlasts the truth.
